unmapped_fields.reason: The native header 'Customer Name' and the documentation phrase 'business or individual name' do not establish the registered legal name role required for entity.legal_name; no trading-name or legal-name mapping is supported without evidence.

The 'Registration Date' header is the register entry date and does not establish the entity registration event required for entity.date_registered; no date mapping is supported and no observation time or validity slot is declared.
The RSO register reference number is an internal register identifier and has no supported canonical entity field in the ontology subset.

The status value 'Registered' describes the register entry status and is not an explicit canonical entity.status value (active, deregistered, in_liquidation, suspended, unknown); no status mapping is supported without evidence.
